head: cleanup/capability-template-registry
summary: Mechanical path-rename PR. Dev-cli code defaults and usage text correctly updated to registry/capability-templates in merge commit 6b3262af; 12 nextest tests + cargo-check/clippy/fmt all green; 5 ADR amendments are coherent path-substitutions but undated. Quality-blocking issue: six .omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.<uuid>.* files were committed as real tracked artifacts because .gitignore has no rule for them. Deletion-safety issue: docs/decisions/specs/deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md duplicates docs/specs/deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md (21KB each, both edited in this PR) — a single doc is now in two canonical locations, both updated in lockstep, indicating accidental fork.

findings.issue: Six .project-memory.json.tmp.<uuid>.* files (4.5K-12.3K each) are tracked in git and edited by this PR. These are tool scratch files (atomic-write temp shadows of project-memory.json). No .gitignore rule excludes .omc/*.tmp.* or .omc/.*.tmp.*. Every future write to project-memory.json will dirty 7 files instead of 1, polluting diffs and review.
findings.fix: Add `.omc/*.tmp.*` and `.omc/.*.tmp.*` to .gitignore; `git rm --cached .omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.*` in a follow-up PR; consider whether project-memory.json itself should be tracked at all.

findings.issue: Same spec exists at two paths (both 21KB, both touched by this PR with identical +1/-1 path-rename edits). docs/decisions/specs/ is a non-canonical location — specs belong under docs/specs/ per repo convention; docs/decisions/ is reserved for ADRs. Lockstep editing confirms accidental duplication, not intentional mirror.
findings.fix: Delete docs/decisions/specs/deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md (and the sibling deep-dive-trace-* file); audit docs/decisions/specs/ for other duplicates; add a CI lane that rejects docs/decisions/specs/**.

findings.issue: Five ADR amendments substitute `product-control/capabilities/` → `registry/capability-templates/` but carry no `Amended: 2026-05-16 — path topology moved per cleanup/capability-template-registry` superseded-by/amended-by header. ADR amendments without date+reason hurt forensic traceability when paths are later revisited.
findings.fix: Follow-up PR adding an Amendments section to each touched ADR with date, PR ref, and one-line reason.

findings.issue: PR body admits `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` were not run locally (`toolchain lacks the subcommand`). CI compensated (cargo-fmt + cargo-clippy jobs both green), so not blocking, but contributor toolchain is broken — risks future PRs landing fmt/clippy regressions locally before push.
findings.fix: Add a note to docs/checklists/pre-push.md: install rustup component add rustfmt clippy; or pin a toolchain file.

findings.issue: No test asserts the new default `registry/capability-templates` path resolves to a real directory containing at least one record. parse_foundry_capability_schema_validate_args default is silently rebindable; if registry/ is ever moved again, only an integration run catches it.
findings.fix: Add `#[test] fn default_capabilities_dir_exists()` in foundry_capability_schema_cli.rs asserting Path::new("registry/capability-templates").is_dir().

positive_observations: All 14 CI checks green at merge (cargo-check, cargo-nextest, cargo-fmt, cargo-clippy, foundry-fitness lanes).
Dev-cli source defaults AND usage help text updated consistently in same commit (both gate parsers + lib.rs usage string).
Registered new artifact rows in registry/artifact-capabilities-registry.json (+105 lines) — registry-as-source-of-truth pattern honored.
Three rename-with-edit operations on YAML templates preserved git rename detection (RENAMED changeType in PR meta), keeping blame intact.
Multispectrum evidence file attached at evidence/multispectrum/capability-template-registry-cleanup-1778915963.json before merge.
